text.answer: He flies in a chosen direction over terrain and can cast abilities during flight. His breath has no cooldown or maximum channel duration while flying, deals increased flat damage, and slows his flight while channeled. Recent champion takedowns greatly reduce his flight cooldown, and immobilizing crowd control interrupts the flight.
text.counterplay: Use immobilizing crowd control to contest his flight and stay alert for renewed pursuit after takedowns.
